description: This is a Java service class named TagService within a book project. It provides methods to find, save, count, and delete Tag entities using a TagRepository. It encapsulates the business logic related to Tags in the application.

classes.name: TagService
classes.description: Service class for managing Tag entities, providing methods to find, save, count, and delete tags.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a Tag by its unique ID.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Finds a Tag by its name, trimming any whitespace.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a Tag if its name is not already taken.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total count of Tag entities.
